U13-C-BT-BEFORAN.claim: Local accusative marks movement into someone’s presence or placing something into position before an object.
U13-C-BT-BEFORAN.editorial_normalized_excerpt: Hē beforan þone cyning gelǣd wæs; Hē þone āsette beforan þæt weofod.
U13-C-BT-BEFORAN.normalization_note: This auxiliary excerpt changes source acute length marks to macrons and capitalizes initial letters for legibility. The facsimile remains authority; no learner text is transcribed from this excerpt.
U13-C-BT-BEFORAN.evidence_limits: This supports a declared composition using accusative beforan in prostration. It does not attest the exercise sentence. Cook154.10–11 independently attests reflexive prostration with fore, a different preposition. Static dative before remains valid and must not be rejected as ungrammatical.
